_about: THE SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH FOR WHAT IS BUILT. One claim per fact about a construct of BIO_System_Design.md §3, each carrying PROBES that `node tools/status.mjs --check` re-runs against the code; the push guard refuses a push when any probe disagrees. §3's state column is RENDERED from this file (`node tools/status.mjs --write`) and never hand-edited. Other documents POINT here; they never restate status. Look anything up with `node tools/status.mjs <topic>`. Established 2026-09-18 by BOB #14 at Bob's direction; the initial claims were verified at the code by three independent reads and a spot-check of five.
